name: O0O0
author: MinigunGD77
description: Press and hold the bottom left corner of the second black orb at 5%. Stop holding briefly to go over the first block at 6% without hitting the invisible saw above. Start holding again at the second block to go above the level between the invisible saws. Fly above the level until 66% where you have to fly upwards and stay right below the gear until 76%. Start falling at around 74.8% to land on a platform. Free to the end from there.
